generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
The lowest bidder will furnish security deposit amount (5.00 % of amount put to tender) before the work order is given or 4 days from the date of acceptance whichever is earlier(DD/FDR).
The contractor should complete the work within the stipulated period. The contractor should maintain the works upto 2 years maintenance period

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The work will be placed under third party inspection
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt Orders.

The work should be executed strictly as per the tender specification mentioned. Constractor should arrange for quality check at different stage of work for quality assurance as per direction of Engineer-in-charge during the work in progress and after completion. If any failures found the cost will be recovered from the contractor and will be recomminded for black listing immediately.
As per KW1 rules contractor must submit the Percentage of nature of work done 30 Percentage of lines of credit 50 Percentage quantities of work done Five years annual turnover CA certificate 50
The Bidders Must have machiners JCB/ Hitache And Oil Generator for this work

Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)
